map.name: traces-of-the-unlived
map.of: Ways a represented or prepared-for alternative that does not occur within an episode changes the actual episode through an identifiable carrier, including by preventing a carrier or witness from forming.
items: Missing alarm: an event that never happens initiates a real response because a stored schedule makes its nonarrival detectable; without the expectation and a clock, there is no signal.
Counterfactual dye: comparing an actual object with a rejected version makes one of its previously unnoticed features conspicuous; the alternative changes attention rather than the object.
Refusal accent: steering a sentence away from a word one decides not to say produces its peculiar rhythm and circumlocutions; the suppressed wording is absent, but the avoidance operation is audible.
Disinherited skill: practice for a role never taken survives as a way of handling other work; the unrealized pianist may remain in how someone times a difficult conversation.
Reserved vacancy: a place kept empty for someone who never arrives changes who sits together and which relationships can form; the empty chair is an allocation, not an apparition.
Ghost load: beams sized for an unbuilt upper floor still determine the rooms below—their span, cost, and usable space—after the expansion plan is lost.

Orphaned affordance: earthworks prepared for a reservoir never filled leave hollows that collect seasonal water; organisms occupy a habitat produced by preparation for a different habitat, without representing that absent future.

Fossil distinction: a vocabulary coined for a canceled project remains in everyday classification, allowing some differences to be named effortlessly while others require explanation; an unrealized undertaking bequeaths a perceptual convenience.

Extinct question: a metric built to choose between two proposed systems remains the measure of success after one is abandoned; the surviving system keeps answering a comparison that is no longer the decision anyone faces.

Winner's negative: a surviving standard retains a prohibition introduced to distinguish it from a rejected rival, even after the rival is forgotten; exclusion preserves the lost design as an unexplained edge of the legal design space.

Mercy without a scene: a concession made to avert a predicted confrontation leaves its beneficiaries with better terms but no shared scene of winning them; the forecast acts through the conceding party.

Permission ash: people decline apprenticeships because they expect a prohibition that is never enacted; later permission cannot instantly supply the practitioners or teaching lineages that anticipation prevented.

Unassembled witness: preempting a confrontation also prevents strangers from discovering that they have the same grievance; separate private memories survive, but the collective capable of comparing them never forms.

Baseline laundering: successfully preventing a forecast disaster keeps its damage out of the local record; if later evaluation treats that record as untreated history, the protection appears to have had nothing to do.
Vacancy tenant: people organize a use for space reserved for a future that does not arrive, then acquire a stake in preventing that future; preparation for an alternative breeds its opponents.

Counterfactual custody: speculative institution—an office for an abandoned proposal retains its assumptions and revises what would count as evidence against them, so later decisions still encounter an organized alternative without pretending it was implemented.

seriation.axis: From a missing event that can still be named to a missing capacity to name what was lost; then a turn through self-defending absence toward deliberate reconstruction.
seriation.note: An authored itinerary, not a scalar ranking. Missing alarm begins with an explicit template. The route passes through bodily and material carriers, inherited categories, and absences of practitioners or collective witnesses. Its consequential adjacency is Unassembled witness → Baseline laundering: the people who might challenge the misleading record may themselves be among the things prevention kept from forming. Vacancy tenant then makes absence actively self-preserving; Counterfactual custody is a proposed counter-movement, not the highest score.

boundary_claim: These are authored distinctions and conditional examples, not verified historical case studies or claims of comprehensive coverage.
Several mechanisms can coexist in one episode; overlap does not imply identity, and sequence does not assert causal necessity.
Reconstructing the cause of an absence requires evidence of the actual anticipation, intervention, or preparation; the absence alone cannot identify which alternative mattered.
Counterfactual custody cannot observe the unimplemented world's outcomes. Its promise is preserving contestable assumptions and live comparisons, not manufacturing counterfactual evidence.

case_in: A witness that never assembled: a hearing of the State Patient Complaint Docket is the only setting in which two patients of Alder Regional Hospital's emergency department who returned within 72 hours of discharge could learn that they returned for the same cause, since each patient knows only their own return, and no such hearing has convened between January 2018 and June 2025, because since January 2018 the department has telephoned every patient counted in its 72-hour re-presentation share within a week of the return, offered a waiver of the second visit's fee, and asked for a signed release that includes not filing with the docket; 214 releases were signed and no docket complaint concerning a 72-hour return has been filed. The department does this because the share is its registered quality indicator. The share, patients who return within 72 hours of discharge divided by patients discharged that month, was defined in 2017 by the Triage Selection Committee, three clinicians, as the one outcome on which Protocol Q, a five-level triage, and Protocol P, a two-stream fast-track, were predicted to differ; Q was adopted. The committee worked in a hosted project board holding P's proposal, the predictions, and the argument; the board was decommissioned in March 2020 without export, and no copy of P's proposal exists anywhere else. On 3 November 2017 the quality officer, Rhea Lindqvist, filed the share's definition with the State Health Register under Rule 14 as the department's quality indicator; the register is kept by the state, readable by hospitals but not editable or deletable by them, every entry carrying the filing hospital, the date, and the filing officer's name, and it was built to hold the definition, the hospital, the date, and the officer, and not the purpose. The filing carries no statement of purpose, and neither the register nor anything at the hospital names Protocol P. The filed definition is, word for word, the text now in the department's dashboard configuration. Since January 2018 the hospital has filed the share monthly, and the register publishes only the monthly figure, naming nobody. No member of the 2017 committee remains, and Lindqvist left in 2019. In August 2025 the current quality manager, Dana Okafor, who joined in 2023, preparing the annual indicator review, reads the definition in the dashboard configuration and in the register, finds them identical and the filing signed by Lindqvist on 3 November 2017, so the definition's source is readable from the arrangement and not inferred, finds nothing at the hospital or in the register saying why this outcome and not another is the indicator, and drafts the review with the share listed as 'legacy indicator, purpose not recorded, recommend retire'.

fence_out.rule: A metric that keeps answering a comparison nobody faces, with the abandoned decision still on record, is here; the same kept distinction whose question the keeper can no longer ask, because the window that held it is gone, is context-horizons', and what changes across is whether the dead question can still be found.
fence_out.to_of: A mechanism by which the edge of what a reasoner can currently see changes what it can conclude, named with what lies past the edge (a cut thing's tail, a named body, the carrier itself, the reasoner's own compacted turns, the next page, a criterion's remainder, the thing a projection stands for, the present, the reader's window, another window's work, another window's half, a ruled-out transcript, the window's own layout, the choices behind its contents, the source of each sentence in it, the reasons for the reasoner's own earlier work, the window's own far edge, a thing nothing in the window names), the carrier that could bring it in, what bringing it in costs in the window, and the failure in which the edge is mistaken for the world's edge with its tell, and sorted by where the mark of the edge sits, from a mark the carrier wrote into the window beside an address, through marks in the window that the reasoner must read as tells, a count, a query, a command line, a date, a pointer in its own prose, to marks that sit with another window or a rule, to marks that sit with nobody who is in the window, the medium, the designer, the source, the reasoner's closed earlier self, the harness, and to no mark anywhere at all.
